title: P0: Side panel opens with a transparent non-blocking overlay
verifies: the side panel opens from Services Catalog and its overlay is present but non-blocking (pointer-events-none, no dim)

title: P0: Clicking outside the panel keeps it open and the behind page stays interactive
verifies: an outside click on a second catalog row does not dismiss the non-modal drawer and the click still reaches the catalog, swapping the panel title in place

title: P1: Close button dismisses the panel; reopening shows the correct service
verifies: the close button hides the drawer and reopening on a different service shows that service's title

title: P1: Escape key closes the non-modal panel
verifies: pressing Escape with focus outside an input/listbox dismisses the drawer

title: P1: RED charts and Operations table render for a concrete stream
verifies: the RED charts section and the Operations table (with operation/requests/errors/p75/p95/p99 columns) render without hanging

title: P1: Metrics tab resolves without hanging
verifies: the Metrics tab's correlation state machine terminates into a terminal state (header/empty/error acceptable)

title: P1: View Related Traces navigates to traces search
verifies: View Related → Traces switches the traces search mode (URL ?tab=traces)

title: P2: Resource tabs render for a service with resource attributes
verifies: a dynamically-discovered OTEL resource tab renders its table (skipped when no resource attributes are seeded)

title: P2: Operations empty state renders without hanging when a service has no operations
verifies: the operations empty branch renders 'No operations found' without a hung spinner (skipped when the service has operations)
